text:
The change moves noc2's access port from VLAN 99 (noc, 10.99.0.0/24) to VLAN 98 (noc-lab, 10.98.0.0/24). The ticket doesn't say whether noc2 should be re-addressed, but the diff only changes the VLAN. The intent appears to be that noc2 now has the same access as the noc-lab hosts (noclab1/noclab2). I test that noc2 behaves like noclab1, that noc1 and the other noc hosts are unaffected, and that noc2 no longer has noc-zone access.
